name: West Electric & Machine
old_description: West Electric & Machine Co. specializes in fast, reliable electric motor repair for all types of industries. We've been providing superior service since 1970. Call us today to let us know how we can serve you.
about:
West Electric & Machine Co., Inc. has been based in Morgantown, West Virginia since its founding in 1970. The company operates as an electric motor repair service for industrial clients. Information about ownership structure or founders is not publicly available.

The shop focuses on the repair and maintenance of electric motors across a range of types and sizes, offering both scheduled maintenance and 24/7 emergency response for urgent breakdowns. Details on facility size, employee count, or annual repair volume are not disclosed.

The company states it serves all types of industries, though specific sectors or named customers are not listed. Its service model emphasizes fast turnaround and reliable repairs, aiming to minimize downtime for industrial operations.

West Electric & Machine highlights its long-standing presence since 1970 and its round-the-clock emergency availability as key differentiators. The business was established to provide dependable motor repair support to local industry.
